media.title: "It's On the Tip of My Tongue" Syndrome | Memory Techniques

timecodes.what: Opening visual framing (kf_002.jpg–kf_005.jpg) depicting an adult pausing mid-sentence when a familiar name locks on the tip of the tongue despite clear recall of who the person is.
Mid-clip sequence (kf_007.jpg–kf_011.jpg) illustrating how partial first-letter clues surface while straining for wrong blocker names deepens the retrieval stall.

media.title: Transient forgetting: on the tip of your tongue

timecodes.what: Scripps Research overview distinguishing transient retrieval blocks (intact stored memory with temporary phonological link failure) from true memory erasure.
Discussion of why stepping away or changing retrieval context lets the blocked word surface spontaneously.
